title: How long does it take to see progress with ABA therapy in a child with autism?
metaTitle: Progress with ABA Therapy for Children with Autism - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Discover the timeline for progress with ABA therapy for children with autism. Learn about the variations in progress rates and continual assessment at Pinnacle Blooms Network.
html: The duration to witness notable progress greatly varies amongst children since every child’s needs and progress rates are different. Some may show progress within a few weeks, while others may need a few months. Continual assessment is done to measure progress during the therapy tenure.
